nodes.label: SPA fallback deployment (serve index.html for unmatched paths)
nodes.rationale: The WASM binary reads window.location.pathname at boot via router.CurrentPath(); if the server 404s a deep link the app never bootstraps. Serving index.html for unmatched paths lets the WASM load, read the URL, and render client-side. goowee routing is path-based (History API), not hash-based; a <base href> lets the same binary work at root or a sub-path.
